decisive_items: Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration
Positive for: pancytokeratin (AE1/AE3), cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies.
Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
response.rationale: Apocrine gland carcinoma is supported by apocrine glands intimately associated with tumor cells and GATA3/ER positivity; extramammary Paget disease is contradicted by absence of epidermal involvement.

rejected.why: Paget disease requires epidermal involvement, but biopsy explicitly states no epidermal involvement; also ER positivity and apocrine association favor apocrine carcinoma.
